displayName: Number of days until password expires
description: Enter the number of days, until the device password must be changed, from 1-365. For example, enter 90 to expire the password after 90 days. When the password expires, users are prompted to create a new password. If the value is blank, Intune doesn't change or update this setting. Available for fully managed, dedicated and corporate-owned work profile devices (at work profile level).
